title: atriplex nuttallii subsp. tridentata
intro: Atriplex nuttallii subsp. tridentata, commonly known as Big Sagebrush, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Amaranthaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, as well as therapeutic actions like reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and soothing respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Big Sagebrush include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to aid in digestion, relieve stress, and boost the immune system.
